stages.title: Pilot admission and fail-closed ledger
notes: Complete cost chain: partial usage makes costOf undefined; settle charges the bound, keeps unknown and refuses further sends. Only a B-owned sender module is imported (reservation identity echoed); E never spawns a descriptor command. 66 checks, refusal sends 0.

stages.title: Eight-case three-arm bounded pilot
notes: Real execute chain is implemented but BLOCKED on adapter_missing; B-owned entry, no CLI fallback, no sample replacement.

cases.reason: The legacy record_decision command returned rejected (unsupported_capability); explicit decisions use /v1/decisions (E3-DECISION-WORKFLOW), but structured proposal confirmation remains absent.
No route-advice producer or HTTP entry exists; the schema fixture and gate validators are prepared, and the default path remains closed.
Project settings GET returned 422 and POST returned 422 (unsupported_capability).

stages.title: Proposal HTTP, attention, decisions and review timing
notes: E3-PROPOSAL-HTTP and E3-PROPOSAL-UI cover explicit proposal flows. E3-CONTEXT-PREVIEW now runs against real HTTP: bounded budget with clamping, untrusted trust label, work/contract sources, no execution effect, TTL, cross-project/foreign-conversation/missing-work/invalid-budget refusals. E2-EVIDENCE-HISTORY covers window/limit/cursor. E5-CONTEXT-USE stays NOT_TESTED because only preview and the binding schema exist, not a send/audit path.

cases.reason: Explicit decisions now work over HTTP (E3-DECISION-WORKFLOW); automatic context/proposal confirmation is still absent.
No public entry creates a review Work/Ticket/Assignment or publishes ReviewEvidence; the independent pilot preflight is BLOCKED on pricing.
No public entry creates a question with a real decisionDeadline/expiresAt in this checkout; waiting-age and unknown-wait ordering are verified instead.
No public entry deletes/changes the source message or expires the project grant; transaction-failure injection is not exposed. These remain NOT_TESTED.

NOT_TESTED: context preview now exists, but automatic proposal confirmation and grant/revocation invalidation do not. Required inputs: proposal id/revision, source message and digest, current grant/scope/profile/contract, decision to confirm, plus context preview with project/conversation/work binding, window and invalidity. Planned negatives: unconfirmed means no execution; a failed original command leaves no half-confirmed state; an unknown response reuses the same command id; source/actor/grant/scope/profile/version drift is refused; revoke invalidates later context; cross-project isolation and reopen.

NOT_TESTED: E3-CONTEXT-PREVIEW verifies clamped budgets, omissions and basic refusals, but no public entry binds an expired grant or purpose mismatch to the read path. Required: expired grant, purpose mismatch, caller budget above the grant and negative/NaN budget must be refused before any provider read, with the effective window and truncation reported. The C composer probe shows these still fail at the library boundary, so a product pass cannot be claimed.

stages.title: Explicit baseline/target installation and upgrade
notes: Install matrix is parameterized by the real tar/sha/source/build/schema tuple (no fixed schema13/ports). E3-PERSONAL-COLD-START proves personal first-run, doctor, workbench assets, bearer refusal, DB schema and stop; a different config release is refused as release_source_conflict. Managed upgrade/rollback keeps data, tampered target is refused, and a cross-schema old binary refuses with state_schema_newer_than_binary after pointer rollback. E4-MULTI-STATE records a real D defect: a stop for state A returned STOPPED and killed shared-install state B's API; the launcher-dead window is therefore NOT_TESTED. Crash windows remain E4-UPGRADE-FAULTS NOT_TESTED.

cases.reason: Distribution source paths absent from this checkout: launcher, distribution, portability. A frozen tar.gz is published outside Git and independently accepted by E4-INSTALL-*; source-level installation and migration remain Agent D owned and are not claimed by this case.

Read-only inspect/prepare are verified (plan authorization=not_granted, commitAvailable=false, no writes, stale/foreign/commit refused). The commit path, expiry/drift/replay/rollback of a real grant, and activation of only new work are not implemented and stay NOT_TESTED.

NOT_TESTED: the bounded managed-upgrade probe covers the confirmed switch, new data, binary rollback and a tampered target. D exposes PA_UPGRADE_FAULT crash windows and whole-process guards, but exercising them reliably needs a longer isolated run; this case stays NOT_TESTED rather than counting two fixture starts as an upgrade result.

stages.title: Recovery authorization windows and bounded stability
notes: Recovery inspect/prepare replay, restart drift and no-write are verified; commit/activation and the interruption windows remain NOT_TESTED until main publishes them. Bounded cycles only.

cases.reason: NOT_TESTED: main publishes the context preview and the AssistantContextBinding contract, but no context-use HTTP or provider attachment. Required: an explicit per-message selection, revalidation of source/contract/grant immediately before send, a binding and receipt in the same transaction, no automatic resend after a lost response/unknown result, and a source audit showing what was used. A preview or the binding schema is not a send.
No executed native stop/question/recovery evidence is available in this checkout.

NOT_TESTED: main has published RecoveryTargetConfiguration/preparation/material/inventory schemas and a configuration binder, but no commit/activate HTTP or composed target startup. Required inputs: source-committed activation fact, A read-only inventory, D materializer readback, main activation pointer switch, and crash replay semantics. Planned negatives: interruption before source commit, after source commit but before target preparation, during target preparation, and at pointer switch must never dispatch old queues, never grant authority from an old ended/PID/missing writer, and never duplicate authorization on response loss or restart; a backup/re-restore must not inherit executable authority. A schema or read-only prepare is not activation.

stages.title: Layered conclusions and handoff
notes: wave10-status separates test source, product source/build and the exact artifact tuple with commands, exit codes, PASS/FAIL/NOT_TESTED and owners; wave09 and older ledgers are preserved and pilot value never gates product or install.
Controlled fixture, SDK mock, readonly and installed evidence never substitute for actual-native execution.
A NOT_TESTED or BLOCKED gap is honest only when the release claim excludes that capability; there is no allow-gap switch.

externalBlockers.detail: One install, two state roots: `pa stop --data-root <state A>` returned 0/STOPPED while state B was recorded, and state B's API process died (launcher remained). Minimal repro: start A, stop A, start B, then stop with A's data root; observed exit 0, bAlive true, bApiAlive false. D must bind the instance record to the exact state root and refuse to stop another state.

Context preview and evidence history are verified over real HTTP; context use (explicit selection, pre-send revalidation, same-transaction binding/receipt, no auto-resend, source audit) and recovery activation are unpublished.
Migration ownership and review Work/Ticket/Assignment publication remain outside current main, so E3-REVIEW-PIPELINE stays NOT_TESTED.

The wave-09 target tuple (6830e38 build f2390ffd, schema 15) passes byte-for-byte, personal cold start and same-schema managed upgrade; cross-schema old-binary refusal is measured. Any newer target must be named with its own tar/source/build/schema and independently re-tested.
Native ledger/results are not supplied as input and E has no budget, so actual-native and native control evidence are absent.

next: D: bind the single install instance record to its exact data root and make a stop aimed at another state refuse without signalling that state's launcher/API; then E can measure launcher-dead/API-alive and PID/start reuse windows.

C/main: publish automatic proposal/context confirmation, the context-use send path (explicit selection, revalidation, same-transaction binding/receipt, no auto-resend, source audit) and recovery activation; E then converts E5-CONTEXT-USE and E5-RECOVERY-INTERRUPTION from NOT_TESTED.
D: keep the target immutable; a new target needs its own explicit identity (tar/sha/source/build/schema) and a fresh E4 run, not a mapping from build f2390ffd.
B: hand off native evidence bound to commit/attempt/command with executed=true and model-task counts; only a separately granted budget lets E re-run native.
Main: treat controlled-product-workflow PASS as workflow evidence only; local-alpha and full-product remain non-zero until installation and native evidence exist.
